title: Maratón de Buenos Aires 2026: 16,384 runners from 64 countries — Infobae
claims: Infobae reports 16,384 runners from 64 countries in the 2026 Maratón de Buenos Aires.
The race started at 07:00 at the intersection of Avenida Presidente Figueroa Alcorta and Dorrego in Palermo.
The course passed Recoleta, the Obelisco, Casa Rosada and Puerto Madero, among other landmarks.
Infobae reports Bethwel Kibet Chumba as men's winner in 2:08:28 and Rebecca Kangogo Chesir as women's winner in 2:23:36, a new course record.
Infobae is a media report, not the official result system; its times are cross-checked against World Athletics where possible.
